name: labs
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: healthcare SaaS website hero illustration, standalone landscape scene for a 3:2 container.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their playful editorial hand-drawn visual language: confident slightly imperfect rounded black outlines, simple angular noses, tiny vertical black eyes, clean white filled figures, open uncluttered composition and a few flat coloured details. Avoid the glow visible around Image 1: no glow, gradients or shadows.
Composition: one compact coherent scene, all characters and objects fully contained with generous transparent breathing room at every edge. Large readable forms at 440px display width. No background rectangle, scenery, floor plane or decorative frame. Genuine transparent alpha outside the opaque white figures and props.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, captions, UI screenshots or watermarks. No photorealism, 3D, dense detail, green or medical procedure imagery. Friendly, calm, professional.
Subject: a friendly female lab technician in a white coat welcoming a patient at a low reception counter; a simple upright microscope and one capped sample tube sit safely on the counter. The patient holds a small appointment card. This is arrival and coordination, not testing or interpreting results. Colour palette: black, white, restrained soft lavender (#b39ada) and a few pale lavender accents.
